description: Agent Knowledge: submit a knowledge scope statement with the entries behind it: each topic the agent claims to cover, with the other names entries use for it, and each knowledge entry with its id, the topics it covers and optionally its claim. The signed report counts the entries behind every claimed topic, matching topic names and their aliases without case, spacing or punctuation, gives each topic as covered, resting on a single entry or empty, counts the entries inside the claim, partly outside it, outside it and naming no topic, lists the topics entries name outside the claim with the entries that name them, and names the gaps between what the agent claims to know and what it holds: claimed topics with no entries at all; then claimed topics resting on a single entry and entries that cover topics outside the claimed scope, with the fix for each. Entries that name no topic count toward none and are named as open points. A name shared by two scope topics is refused before any charge. The tasks a delegate may do are wever_delegation-scope-check, what an agent memory may hold is wever_memory-scope-check and whether every action an agent takes is traced is wever_observability-coverage-check. Verdict topics_uncovered, topic_gaps, topics_unverified or topics_covered. POST /api/knowledge-coverage-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-knowledge-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-knowledge/.

entries.description: Each knowledge entry with its topics.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

scope.description: Each topic in the scope statement.

aliases.description: Other names entries use for it.

topic.description: A topic the agent claims to cover, such as returns.
